name: Projection Coherence Stress Test Scaffold Registry
purpose: Create stress-test scaffolding for projection agreement, projection conflict, recoverability limits, flattening risks, and projection-induced failure modes.

stress_test_classes.name: shared_source_projection_agreement
stress_test_classes.purpose: Test whether multiple projections declare the same source relation without claiming source reconstruction.

stress_test_classes.name: projection_conflict_detection
stress_test_classes.purpose: Detect conflicting retained features between projections of the same source relation.

stress_test_classes.name: recoverability_overclaim_injection
stress_test_classes.purpose: Inject claims that projected forms recover ⇔R without trace metadata and verify rejection.

stress_test_classes.name: flattening_risk_injection
stress_test_classes.purpose: Inject equality, implication, composition, or biconditional flattening claims and verify audit detection.

stress_test_classes.name: geometry_primitive_promotion_injection
stress_test_classes.purpose: Inject projection-induced geometry primitive claims and verify rejection.

stress_test_classes.name: physics_escalation_injection
stress_test_classes.purpose: Inject QM/GR unification or physical derivation claims and verify rejection.

required_test_behaviors: Projection agreement must not imply source identity.
Projection conflict must be recorded instead of collapsed.
forbidden_outcomes: Projection agreement promoted to theorem evidence.
Geometry projection promoted to physical geometry.
QM/GR projection language promoted to unification claim.
